thesis.final_decision: whether the collection-failure, retry and skipped-slot policy pre-registered for attempt 3 of the frozen funding-carry paper screen (pre-registration packet digest 29467597161a8856c97e2b9c46094e185bef84eed304ac7f33f75edf1ddbea10) is implemented exactly as registered, so that a fresh result-blind review of this packet's exact digest and heads can be requested and only then a separate explicit economic authorization (Issue #810). This is the implementation packet for the collector, the durable attempt and skip registry and the failure classification. It authorizes no seal, launch, storage probe, network access, order or economic run, and it cannot support a seal by itself: the carry_paper_screen_v3 plan, the evaluator audit of registered failures and the attempt-lineage version naming attempt 2 do not exist at its implementation_head.
thesis.hypothesis: The economic hypothesis is exactly that of the attempt-2 packet (digest 617988282ad6dfbf0ee7188f002676a1675dfac38c9ac969071bee3091b2e770): a matched BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT spot-long / USD-M perpetual-short carry with fixed monthly equal-quantity targets (gross 0.5, common lot 0.001, irreversible 10% drawdown stop), executed only against later recorded depth under the declared fees and adverse-price assumptions, earns positive net virtual-USDT profit above recorded fees over a fresh ninety-day window, positive in each of three thirty-day blocks, with nonzero funding receipts in every block, while staying flat at the terminal close. Attempt 3 changes no economic parameter and no economic acceptance criterion. Any reused 2023-2024 development replay of the same fixed family is reused-development evidence only and is not evidence for the prospective window; no development economic outcome is recorded in this packet.
thesis.economic_mechanism: Unchanged from the attempt-2 packet: when the perpetual funding rate is positive, long perpetual holders pay short holders at each published settlement (00:00, 08:00 and 16:00 UTC); a spot-long / perpetual-short pair of equal quantity hedges price exposure and collects the transfer, net of two-venue taker fees, depth-limited adverse fills and basis or hedge-break risk. The decision chain (source, availability, feature_state, model_strategy, intent, order, fill, accounting, evidence, decision) is the attempt-2 chain. What attempt 3 adds is an explicit, result-blind specification, now implemented in the collector, of two operational layers that decide whether an observation window is usable evidence: the timing tolerances of the public-data freshness checks, and the response to a collection failure. Both are justified from venue and engineering mechanism only: the time a public REST response needs, the cross-request skew inside one capture, the decision-to-execution window of the paper engine and the frozen 180-second observation-gap limit. No attempt-1 or attempt-2 timing, price, equity or outcome figure was read or used.
thesis.counter_hypothesis: A positive paper result, if any, is explained by something other than a repeatable carry edge: every alternative of the attempt-2 packet (selection of the carry family on seen development data, a single ninety-day regime, optimistic fills at 10% of displayed depth with a flat 5bp adverse buffer and no queue or latency, receipt-time-only spot depth, mark-to-mid spot valuation, funding-rate compression, or an operational artifact), plus the following attempt-3 specific alternatives. (1) Restart selection: attempt 3 exists because attempt 2 ended; if the restart were conditioned on an observed attempt-2 outcome it would be optional stopping. Mitigation: attempt 2 ended from a software defect found in the failure marker, no attempt-2 outcome is read or used, and the attempt-2 root stays unevaluated. (2) Staler quotes: the reader now accepts a capture that was within five seconds at completion and consumed up to ten seconds later, so a venue-stamped mark can be fifteen seconds old at valuation; the flat 5bp adverse buffer is not calibrated to that age, so staler fills may be systematically favourable or unfavourable. (3) Skip selection: slots skipped by the collection policy may coincide with fast or illiquid markets, so the retained observation set may be biased toward calm periods; retries accept a later capture in place of a failed one. The skip budget bounds but does not remove this. (4) Post-hoc tolerance fitting: tolerances could be tuned until a capture succeeds; they are therefore bound to the source constants by a test and may not change after a seal. Implementation-specific alternatives. (5) Reading selection: the pre-registration left implicit whether a transient rules-refresh failure inside the one-hour hold is retried or consumes a budget; the implementation takes the conservative reading (no retry, no budget, proceed on the held rules, a Class D or Class I refresh failure ends the attempt) and states it, so a more tolerant reading could not be chosen after a failure; decisions may run on rules up to one hour old, which is accepted in the G3 boundary. (6) Unregistered skips: a slot that never ran, or a failed capture directory without a registry row, could pass as healthy; both are registered or the cycle stays unacknowledged and the collector halts on reopen. (7) A failed execution capture lets its pending decision expire through the existing permanent data-gap cancellation, so the skip budget does not rescue that case; this is not tuned away.
thesis.information_gain: Pre-registering the tolerances and the failure policy before any attempt-3 data exists means an INVALID outcome is classified by ex-ante rules rather than post hoc, and a valid ninety-day window can falsify the economic hypothesis exactly as in the attempt-2 packet. A rejected frozen screen is a valid failed-hypothesis outcome. A pass shows only that this one window met the frozen criteria under paper assumptions.
thesis.cheapest_falsifier: Ordered by cost. (i) The source-constant binding tests, which fail if any pre-registered timing or policy value diverges from the code (they exist, no network). (ii) Fake-transport collector tests that inject each failure class, each budget breach, a stale-held-rules slot and a retry that would follow a committed decision, against the real collector, journal and control database (tests/evaluation/test_paper_collection_retry.py; they exist, no network). (iii) The review of this implementation packet, which can reject the implementation before anything is sealed. (iv) For the economic hypothesis there is no cheaper falsifier than the frozen screen itself, run once on fresh data; opening unused or additional data, or any attempt-1 or attempt-2 data, to pre-test it is forbidden.
thesis.stop_rule: Do not seal, launch, run the storage probe or touch the network under this packet. This packet cannot support a seal: sealing needs (a) a later packet whose implementation_head contains the carry_paper_screen_v3 plan, the evaluator audit that every failed capture is registered and within budget and the attempt-lineage version naming attempt 2, with a new digest and a fresh result-blind review of its exact digest and heads, (b) explicit owner authorization on Issue #810 naming the UTC start, the run root and the digest, and (c) the collection-policy decision, which Issue #810 comment 6715501420 records as the planner's resolution under the owner's 2026-11-08 delegation. That comment extends only the review-route part of the attempt-2 exception (https://github.com/shuntatsu/trade_rl/issues/810#issuecomment-6680576996) to attempt 3; the attempt-2 predecessor-root-unavailable G0 exception does not extend to attempt 3, and the attempt-2 root is available, so G0 predecessor verification applies in the ordinary way. After a later authorized seal, an INVALID event (any permanent failure marker, a Class D or Class I failure, a skip budget breach, an observation gap over 180 seconds, changed source or runtime identity, clock reversal, an unmatched hedge, drawdown at or above 10%, or a late, missing, revised or out-of-order funding settlement) ends the attempt: no resume, repair or backfill. A failed screen is not rescued by changing criteria, window, symbols, costs, participation, stop level, tolerances or budgets. If attempt 3 is INVALID or rejected, a further attempt needs a new lineage, a new packet, a new review and a new seal, and the carry line stops if the economic screen itself is rejected.
thesis.metric_proxy_rationale: Unchanged from the attempt-2 packet: net marked virtual-USDT equity change against the declared zero-interest cash comparison on the canonical ledger, with once-charged fees, depth-based adverse fills, funding by published settlement time and actual simulated exits, requiring positive net profit, positive return in each thirty-day block, net profit above recorded fees, observed maximum drawdown below 10% and funding receipts in every block. It is a paper proxy; minute sampling is not an intraminute drawdown or liquidity guarantee.
thesis.limitations: Attempt 2 (screen start 2026-11-07T00:00:00Z; frozen checkout C:\trade_rl_frozen\attempt2-d649fe05; run root C:\trade_rl_runs\attempt2\root-20261107) is INVALID: its collector halted at cycle 61 (2026-11-07T00:59:07Z) and wrote collection-failure.json, because read_forward_snapshot re-applied the five-second per-quote age bound at the consumption time to a capture that had passed it at completion (root cause recorded on Issue #810, comment 6711911740; reader fixed by pull request #1164, merge commit cbb56debe99a86c153a185d34eb15e71c98137c0). That is a software defect found from the failure marker, not from any economic observation. Result-blindness: no attempt-1 or attempt-2 price, equity, profit, drawdown, fill or funding figure, no FS1 scoring and no unused or final data was read to write this packet, and none is used. Identity fields needed for the attempt-3 lineage (protocol digest, event count, final tip, last command time) must be read from the preserved attempt-2 root by a reader limited to those fields; the attempt-2 root, its collection-failure.json, its frozen checkout and the carry-a2 scheduled tasks are not touched by this work. Timing tolerances are taken from the source constants and from venue and engineering reasoning only; attempt-2 timing metadata (capture span, quote age, consume latency) was deliberately not used. Pre-registered values: Timing protocol parameters: quote_age_ms=5000; future_skew_ms=1000; request_seconds=5; capture_span_seconds=10; consume_latency_ms=10000; decision_window_seconds=10; depth_receipt_age_seconds=5; worst_case_mark_age_ms=15000. Collection policy parameters: retries_per_slot=2; retry_delay_seconds=2; retry_start_window_seconds=30; max_consecutive_skipped_slots=1; max_skipped_slots_per_hour=2; max_skipped_slots_total=129; cadence_seconds=60; frozen_gap_limit_seconds=180. The timing values are the current constants of trade_rl/integrations/binance/forward.py (MAX_QUOTE_AGE_MS, MAX_QUOTE_FUTURE_SKEW_MS, MAX_REQUEST_SECONDS, MAX_CAPTURE_SPAN_SECONDS, MAX_CONSUME_LATENCY_MS) and the paper decision-window and depth-receipt literals; a test fails if the packet and the source diverge. The worst-case venue-stamped mark age at valuation is quote_age_ms + consume_latency_ms = 15 s. For a fill, depth_receipt_age_seconds bounds the time from the local receipt of the depth response to execution (a local-clock quantity, not a venue timestamp); because a venue-stamped futures depth is at most quote_age_ms old at its receipt, its venue-stamped age at execution is at most 10 s, while spot depth has no venue timestamp and is bounded only by its receipt age. The collection policy was adopted as proposed by the planner under the owner's delegation (Issue #810 comment 6715501420, 2026-11-08; the owner's words 「全部お任せで。一番成果が得られるもので」 delegated the decision and the policy text is not the owner's drafting). It is IMPLEMENTED at implementation_head in the collector: trade_rl/evaluation/paper/collection_policy.py holds the constants, the failure classification and the budget scan; trade_rl/evaluation/paper/control.py holds the durable registry (tables attempts and skips beside the cycle acknowledgements); trade_rl/evaluation/paper/supervisor.py applies them; the permanent failure marker names failure_class D, I or B. The transport chains its final error to the HTTP or socket cause and a capture freshness rejection has its own ValueError subtype, so classification never parses messages. Class D (HTTP 401, 403, 418, 429, 451) and Class I (integrity or unknown) failures end the attempt; Class T failures (timeout, connection or DNS error, HTTP 500, 502, 503, 504, one capture's freshness rejection) get at most 2 retries per slot, 2 s apart, each started within 30 s of the slot start, only before a capture is consumed and never after a decision is committed; a failed execution capture is never retried and lets the pending decision expire. A slot that cannot capture, a slot that never ran, and a slot whose held rules are older than one hour at decision time are skipped slots that append no command and count toward 1 consecutive, 2 per 60 slots and 129 total; a breach of any budget ends the attempt. Rules-refresh classification (closing the non-blocking gap of review 5816161116 using only the registered semantics): a transient rules-refresh failure while the held rules are at most one hour old is not retried, proceeds on the held rules and consumes no retry and no skip budget, and the next slot tries again; a Class D or Class I rules-refresh failure ends the attempt whether or not rules are held; with no held rules, or rules older than one hour, the refresh is required, may use the slot's retries and, if it still fails, the slot is skipped and counted. This is the conservative reading and is flagged for review. Registered values: Timing protocol parameters: quote_age_ms=5000; future_skew_ms=1000; request_seconds=5; capture_span_seconds=10; consume_latency_ms=10000; decision_window_seconds=10; depth_receipt_age_seconds=5; worst_case_mark_age_ms=15000. Collection policy parameters: retries_per_slot=2; retry_delay_seconds=2; retry_start_window_seconds=30; max_consecutive_skipped_slots=1; max_skipped_slots_per_hour=2; max_skipped_slots_total=129; cadence_seconds=60; frozen_gap_limit_seconds=180. The values are imported from the source by tests/evaluation/test_paper_attempt3_implementation_packet.py, which fails if the packet, the specification and the code diverge. Not built at implementation_head and therefore still required before any seal: the carry_paper_screen_v3 plan whose economic fields equal carry_paper_screen_v2, the evaluator audit that every failed capture and skipped slot is registered and within budget, and the attempt-lineage version naming attempt 2 as an available predecessor. The unchanged assessor still rejects any root with a failed capture or a skipped slot (tests/evaluation/test_paper_collection_retry.py pins this), so the policy also relaxes one attempt-2 operational-quality clause only once the v3 plan and the evaluator audit exist; it relaxes no economic criterion. Run identity: run root C:\trade_rl_runs\attempt3\root-<UTC seal date YYYYMMDD>, storage-probe scratch root C:\trade_rl_runs\attempt3\storage-probe-<UTC date YYYYMMDD>, frozen checkout C:\trade_rl_frozen\attempt3-<first 8 hex of the launch commit>, scheduled tasks carry-a3-supervisor and carry-a3-check; none of these exists yet. The attempt-2 seal and protocol digest are never reused and the attempt-3 protocol digest must differ from every earlier digest. The seal, start time, authorization comment and launch commit are PENDING_OWNER_AUTHORIZATION; no seal was computed. Packet heads: protocol_head and implementation_head are the last commit that changes trade_rl/ in the pull request that adds this packet; the packet is committed in a later descendant, so the pull request head is not the implementation_head and tools.research_assurance_github cannot report PASS for this in-tree packet. The pre-registration packet (digest 29467597161a8856c97e2b9c46094e185bef84eed304ac7f33f75edf1ddbea10) stays frozen and is not re-pinned. Review route: under the same delegation (comment 6715501420) the attempt-2 same-account receipt route of comment 6680576996 is extended to attempt 3: a fresh Claude Haiku 5.5 agent, a different model from the Opus planner and the Sonnet implementer, reviews the exact digest and heads result-blind and posts the receipt as a pull request review (event COMMENT, commit_id the reviewed head) from the shuntatsu account. It is operator-enforced, is not different-principal independence, and tools.research_assurance_github rejects same-principal reviews, so the packet stays UNREVIEWED. The attempt-2 predecessor-root-unavailable G0 exception is not extended. Accepted side effects (G3 claim boundary): a failed rules refresh proceeds on held rules up to one hour old; a slot whose held rules are older than one hour at decision time is a skipped slot that appends no command and counts toward the three skip budgets (1 consecutive, 2 per 60 slots, 129 total), and no decision is ever made on rules older than one hour; and skipped slots may coincide with fast markets so retained observations may lean toward calm periods; no claim may extend beyond the retained slots, and every result must report the skip count with its funding-proximity distribution. This work authorizes no seal, launch, probe or economic run. No PASS is claimed. Collection failure classes, as implemented. Class D (denial: HTTP 401, 403, 418, 429 or 451, or any authorization, rate-limit or geo denial) and Class I (integrity: provenance, protocol digest, clock reversal, journal or lock error, malformed or oversized response, crossed or unsorted book, any exception outside Class T) are never retried and end the attempt. Class T (transport timeout, connection or DNS error, HTTP 500, 502, 503 or 504, and a freshness rejection of one capture: stale or future quote, request or capture-span overrun) may be retried only inside the same slot, only before a capture has been consumed by a command, and never after a decision has been committed in that slot: a failed execution capture lets the pending decision expire and the slot is skipped. Each failed attempt keeps its failure evidence and is registered; a skipped slot is one where all attempts fail or the retry start window closes. A breach of any skip budget, or any failure outside Class T, writes the permanent failure marker. A failed rules refresh does not skip a slot while the held rules are no older than one hour: a transient refresh failure proceeds on the held rules, is not retried and consumes no retry and no skip budget, while a Class D or Class I refresh failure ends the attempt; a slot whose held rules are older than one hour at decision time is a skipped slot that appends no command and counts toward the three skip budgets (1 consecutive, 2 per 60 slots, 129 total), a breach ends the attempt INVALID, and no decision is ever made on rules older than one hour. No settlement-specific tolerance is added: the frozen rule that funding first received more than 180 seconds after a settlement is a permanent quality failure continues to apply, and a skipped slot cannot extend it. A death inside a cycle is still never resumed. The attempt-2 protocol, seal and lineage are not reused; the attempt-3 lineage must be read from the preserved attempt-2 root.
